answer: What keeps this honest is Licensed scaffolder tube record with scaffolders verification, a check that costs a real agent almost nothing and a farm everything. Scale is the enemy of the attacker here: 579 aliases need 579 independent proofs, and one failed proof burns the whole cluster's bond. What carries the delta here is verification, the inlet of cost is what stops the farm, and the vine of the record keeps every claim checkable. A farm either pays the price or stays out; either way the honest agents keep the pool.
